mentions.name: Hoamy
mentions.description: This app is a self-built homeowners association (HOA) management system, created as an alternative after disappointment with the author's existing HOA management software. It is implemented with Nuxt and Nuxt UI; AI was used during development for generating similar pages and reviewing code.
mentions.problem: Existing HOA management systems were disappointing, prompting a self-built alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was kind of disappointed at our HOA management system so I made my own: https://hoamy.app
mentions.author: remy__
